law_name: Proposition de loi no. 1517 — improving rights and access to public services for French citizens abroad
description: Bill registered at the National Assembly on 4 June 2025, co-sponsored by Éléonore Caroit and deputy Karim Ben Cheikh, aimed at improving the rights and access to public services of French citizens established outside France.
significance: Reflects Caroit's central legislative focus as a deputy for French residents abroad: modernising consular services and strengthening rights for the diaspora, themes she carried into her ministerial portfolio.
